title: Kayaks Are Done. The Bikes Aren't.
why: Cold, problem-aware fall visitors who assume an e-bike ride to Cave Point takes cycling fitness. Sells the fall rental.
hook_options: You don't need to be a cyclist to ride to Cave Point.
Kayaks are put away. The bikes aren't.
4.5 miles to the cliffs. The motor does the hills.
caption: Kayak season is wrapped. The fat-tire e-bikes are still out. About 4.5 miles from our Jacksonport shop to the Cave Point cliffs, the motor handles the hills, and you set the pace. Layers recommended, October wind is real. #DoorCounty #CavePoint #EBikeDoorCounty #FallInDoorCounty

slides.headline: The bikes aren't.
slides.body: No cyclist required. A fat-tire e-bike gets you from our Jacksonport shop to the Cave Point cliffs.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/Amazing photos to brand/cave point ebike rental.JPG

slides.headline: You have to be a cyclist.
slides.body: Most people who rent from us have never been on an e-bike. If you can ride a regular bike, you're set.

slides.headline: Turn it up and hills feel flat.
slides.body: The motor helps every time you push. Want a workout? Turn the assist down. Your call.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0787 3.jpg

slides.headline: About 4.5 miles to the cliffs.
slides.body: Quiet backroads and bike trails from the shop to Cave Point. A 1-hour rental covers the round trip with a short stop.

slides.headline: Park the bike. Walk to the edge.
slides.body: The cliff edge is a short walk from where you leave the bike. That first look at the limestone shelves is the moment.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_2569 copy.jpg

slides.headline: Tops out around 20 mph.
slides.body: That's the assisted top speed. You set the pace. Nobody's timing you.

slides.headline: Assist off inside Whitefish Dunes.
slides.body: Power isn't permitted in the state park. Switch it off and ride the easy park trails like a regular bike.

slides.headline: Dress for the wind off the lake.
slides.body: It can be 50 at the shop and colder at the cliffs. Layers, gloves, a hat you can pocket, closed-toe shoes.

slides.headline: No cyclist required. Hills handled.
slides.body: 4.5 miles to Cave Point. Assist off in the state park. Layers in your pocket.

slides.kicker: Save this for your fall trip
slides.headline: E-bike rentals are open this fall.
slides.body: Book at doorcountykayaktours.com. Send this to the friend who says they can't bike that far.
